sources.title: blaj/Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated-DFlash-bf16-ov · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What this is A DFlash draft model — it is not run standalone. It attaches to a Qwen3.5-9B target and proposes candidate tokens that the target verifies. It must be paired with a target of matching geometry (see Pairing below).

sources.title: GitHub - z-lab/dflash: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative ...
sources.snippet: The MLX backend supports DFlash 2 for Qwen3.8-27B, and DFlash for Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Gemma 4. Qwen3.8 uses reasoning_effort: low, medium, or xhigh (default). For quantized targets or drafts, use block_size <= 5: MLX's current quantized matmul kernel becomes less efficient at larger verify widths. The example below runs both the target and draft with 4-bit weights.

sources.title: qwen3_dflash - vLLM
sources.snippet: DFlash attention assumes that the KV cache is already populated with the context K/V from the target model's hidden states. This forward op computes attention for the query tokens only.

sources.title: DFlash 2: Keep Drafting Parallel — Inco AI
sources.snippet: DFlash 2 is the successor to our widely deployed parallel drafter: close to 3× the speed of autoregressive decoding, with the same output. Drafters for Qwen3.8-27B and Meta's Muse Glimmer are out today.
